newsitem.title: USA: BPA leaves Monday surplus power prices unchanged.
newsitem.headline: BPA leaves Monday surplus power prices unchanged.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left prices for surplus power delivered on Monday unchanged, while offering heavy load power only on Sunday, the agency said Friday.

BPA continued to offer non-firm power for hours ending at 0600 and 2300 PT on Monday at $9.50 per megawatt hour (MWh) for both Northwest and California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries, while delivered prices for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 were flat at $9.00.
Firm power during off-peak hours on Saturday, Sunday and Monday was also unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
In addition, BPA offered non-firm power between 0900-2200 PTSunday at $12.00 for all deliveries.
